description: Turn a picture of any floor plan — a hand sketch, a photo of a brochure page, a blueprint, a screenshot — into a polished real-estate floor plan: a furnished top-down 2D plan with real floors and room names, or a 3D isometric cutaway. The rooms, walls, doors and windows are kept exactly as drawn; nothing is added and written dimensions are left off. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

imageUrl.description: Public https URL of the source photo, or a data: URI. Either imageUrl or r2Path is required.

look.description: Which picture to make of the plan: 'furnished' (the default — a polished top-down 2D plan with real floors, furniture and room names) or 'isometric' (a 3D cutaway of the same layout, furnished, no text). The photo must show a floor plan: a hand sketch, a brochure page, a blueprint, a screenshot. The layout is kept exactly as drawn; written dimensions are left off.

r2Path.description: Storage path of a photo already in the user's Pixly library (from list_library, or returned by an upload ticket) — the alternative to imageUrl.

name: render_floor_plan

status.description: pending | processing | completed | failed — anything not completed/failed is still running

title: Floor Plan Render
